def find_largest_x(n, S):
    S = sorted(S)
    x = 0
    while (1 << x) <= max(S) * 2:
        x += 1
    return x - 1

def find_magical_permutation(n, S, x):
    permutation = list(range(1 << x))
    permutation[0], permutation[1] = 0, 1
    for i in range(2, 1 << x):
        permutation[i] = permutation[i - 1] ^ S[i % n]
    return permutation
